gbm_population_evidence.quote: Prior resection of histologically diagnosed high-grade gliomas (III and IV) defined as participants who have progressed on or following standard (Stupp regimen) therapy

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Arm 1: Phase 0: 125 mg of infigratinib administered orally for 7 days prior to surgical resection.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Infigratinib in Recurrent High-Grade Glioma Patients

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Total infigratinib concentration in Gd enhancing and Gd non-enhancing tumor tissue collected intraoperatively, approximately 8 hours after study drug administration, will be determined by a validated liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) method.
Total Concentration of Infigratinib in Cerebrospinal Fluid (CSF)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Mean % Change of pERK+ Cells in Resected Post-Treatment Recurrent HGG Tissue vs Baseline Tissue

role_evidence.quote: The Phase 0 study will include treatment of recurrent high-grade glioma participants with 125 mg of infigratinib 7 days prior to surgical resection.

source_quote.quote: Archival tissue must demonstrate: FGFR1 K656E or FGFR3 K650E mutation or FGFR3-TACC3 translocation from NGS sequencing or IHC and RT-PCR.

source_quote.quote: The mean percentage change of pERK positive cells in resected post-treatment recurrent high-grade glioma tumor tissue compared to baseline (archival primary high-grade glioma tumor tissue collected at screening) will be quantified using immunohistochemistry.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: MIB-1 (Ki-67) positive cells in tumour (IHC), post-treatment vs baseline

source_quote.quote: Mean % Change of MIB-1+ Cells in Resected Post-Treatment Recurrent HGG Tissue vs Baseline Tissue

source_quote.quote: Mean % Change of ClCas3+ Cells in Resected Post-Treatment Recurrent HGG Tissue vs Baseline Tissue

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0 translational subset). Population: recurrent high-grade glioma grades III and IV; glioblastoma named in conditions -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named; 'grade IV' without IDH requirement -> cns5_terminology historical. FGFR1/FGFR3 alteration is an entry requirement matched to the FGFR inhibitor infigratinib (primary outcome positive). Tumour tissue and CSF drug concentrations are primary outcomes (tumour PK yes); pERK change in paired post-treatment vs baseline tumour is a pharmacodynamic endpoint (target engagement yes). Expansion cohort continues infigratinib monotherapy after surgery for PK responders.
